note:
R127f - per-arena venue-art list from the handoff 20 section 6 texture-slot rule (the u32 at +256 / +288 of the 0xEF0001 chunk before
each named 0xEF0005 material = the chunk index of a 0x20003 raster descriptor). For every `stadium_<artid>_container_<n>` of the listed trees:
each board-ad / bench-ad / jumbotron / glass / power-ring material with its slot-0 and slot-1 raster (descriptor chunk index, ordinal among
the package's rasters, w x h, format) or the raw slot word when it is not a raster. The developer's input list for a read-only venue-art
gallery; nothing is decoded beyond the descriptors, nothing written. Usage: python r127f_venue_art_slot_list.py <out.json>
